_comment: Ratchet baselines: max tolerated typecheck/lint ERROR counts per workspace. TYPECHECK IS 0 EVERYWHERE, i.e. a hard gate — it is no longer a debt number and must not be raised to accommodate a change. CI fails if a count EXCEEDS its baseline (a regression). When you fix errors and a count drops, lower the matching number here so the ratchet keeps the gain. The packages/* entries are 0 — born clean, so for them this is a hard gate. See agentGuides/testingAndCiSetup.md and .github/scripts/ratchet.sh.
